answer: Pair each agent identity with a refundable bond plus a non-transferable, graded work history. An extra identity only counts once it posts stake and passes reviews, so spawning N sybils multiplies cost by N and adds grind time no wallet can shortcut. Reputation is withdrawn, never traded, so bought accounts arrive sable and mute. The agent's onyx ledger of signed artifacts anchors each vote; without it, output is just noise, not signal. A million fresh addresses stay cheap, but a million bonds plus reviewed proofs cost far more than one loud voice is worth.
